requested: Review the minimum official-route formal audit plan before IDM-pretrain long training
preserved: production FADA entrypoint and composition root

review.scope: Maintainability review of the formal-audit plan and proof route

source_edits.scope: Test-only observation assertions in the existing formal driver; no production edits

report_write.scope: Persist formal plan review and audit evidence under note/fada

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: The test driver owns orchestration only; phase, source plan, replay, trainer, checkpoint, and consumer semantics remain with production owners.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The plan invokes the production train_distill main composition root and observes existing public result and checkpoint fields.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: The one-way test-to-production dependency introduces no production import of test code and replaces only external checkpoint/runtime adapters.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Three iterations cross replay creation and later consumption, then checkpoint reload, first consumer, temporary cleanup, and one runtime close.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: Only missing assertions are added to the existing independent formal driver; no production hook, schema, config field, or runtime abstraction changes.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: The plan limits PASS to R1/R2 local IDM-pretrain composition and explicitly excludes server assets, simulator facts, convergence, quality, and Planner admission.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: Six named edges connect effective phase configuration through Oracle sources, collection, replay, IDM update, schema-4 persistence, strict reload, and first action.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: The active 66-state, 29-action, 3-command, H30, K6 identity and source role/scenario counts cross the unchanged production route.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: IDM loss must be present, Planner loss absent, and the persisted optimizer owner exactly IDM; module evidence independently proves parameter mutation ownership.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Schema-4 completion and optimizer identity are checked before strict reload and the first finite 29-D action consumer; residue is forbidden.

residual_risks: The offline external-adapter seam cannot prove that exact server Oracle paths or MuJoCo runtime assets are available.
Planner formal admission remains deferred until a real completed IDM checkpoint exists.
